title: David Mourns and Returns

questions.question: Who rebuked David for mourning Absalom excessively?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:5-6 (ESV): "...You have today covered with shame the faces of all your servants... in that you love those who hate you and hate those who love you."

questions.question: What did Joab tell David to do?
options: Go out and speak kindly to your servants
questions.correctAnswer: Go out and speak kindly to your servants
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:7 (ESV): "Now therefore arise, go out and speak kindly to your servants..."

questions.question: Who did David ask the elders of Judah to bring back?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:11-12 (ESV): "...Why should you be the last to bring the king back to his house...?"

questions.question: Who came down to meet the king at the Jordan, confessing his sin?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:18-20 (ESV): "And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king... 'Let not my lord hold me guilty...'"

questions.question: What promise did David make to Shimei?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:23 (ESV): "And the king said to Shimei, 'You shall not die.' And the king gave him his oath."

questions.question: Who did David appoint over the army in place of Joab?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:13 (ESV): "And say to Amasa... 'God do so to me and more also, if you are not commander of my army... in place of Joab.'"

questions.question: How did Mephibosheth appear before the king?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:24 (ESV): "...he had neither taken care of his feet nor trimmed his beard nor washed his clothes..."

questions.question: What did David decide regarding Mephibosheth and Ziba's land dispute?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:29 (ESV): "...I have decided: you and Ziba shall divide the land."

questions.question: Who was the elderly Gileadite who provided for the king?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:31-32 (ESV): "Now Barzillai the Gileadite... He had provided the king with food... for he was a very wealthy man."

questions.question: Who went with David to Jerusalem in Barzillai's place?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:37-38 (ESV): "...Here is your servant Chimham. Let him go over with my lord the king..."

questions.question: How old was Barzillai?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:32 (ESV): "...Now he was eigthy years old."

questions.question: Why did the men of Israel argue with the men of Judah?
options: Because Judah stole the king away
questions.correctAnswer: Because Judah stole the king away
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:41 (ESV): "...Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen you away...?"

questions.question: Israel claimed to have how many shares in the king?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:43 (ESV): "...We have ten shares in the king..."

questions.question: Where did David cross the Jordan?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:15, 40 (ESV): "...Judah came to Gilgal to meet the king... Then the king went on to Gilgal..."

questions.question: What did Mephibosheth say when David offered to divide the land?
options: Let him take it all, since my lord the king has come home safely
questions.correctAnswer: Let him take it all, since my lord the king has come home safely
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 19:30 (ESV): "...Oh, let him take it all, since my lord the king has come safely home."

key_verse_text: And he swayed the heart of all the men of Judah as one man, so that they sent word to the king, “Return, both you and all your servants.” (ESV)
